proclamation.speaker: british_officer
proclamation.text: By order of His Majesty: no settlement west of the Appalachian Mountains. All lands beyond are reserved for the Indian nations.

proclamation.speaker: settler
proclamation.text: We fought that war for this land! Now we can't touch it?

proclamation.speaker: lenape_trader
proclamation.text: You fought the French. Nobody asked us. Pontiac's warriors have already burned British forts this summer because settlers keep coming.

officer_lens.speaker: british_officer
officer_lens.text: Ten thousand soldiers to keep peace on this frontier. Do you know what that costs?
